prompts.movement: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite-pose strip for Doodle Rumble Fuse missile stick fighter. Image 1 Fuse hero is exact character identity reference; Image 2 original Orange is game's proportions/brushwork reference. Render THREE separate full-body poses in a horizontal row on transparent alpha. EXACT SAME Fuse in each: faceless black hollow circular head with chipped ivory rim; narrow angular bone-white/graphite stick limbs with a few coral-red paint patches; triangular feet; thick uneven black ink and dry brush scratches; oversized graphite/ivory shoulder launcher carrying an ivory missile with coral conical nose and triangular black fins. No changes to head, weapon, palette or identity. All facing RIGHT, side/three-quarter side view fit for fighting game. Left IDLE: relaxed wide ready stance, both feet flat, launcher rests on shoulder at slight upward angle, no flame or glow cloud. Center RUN START: crouched forward lean preparing to sprint, one foot planted behind, front knee bent, launcher held tightly across shoulder and both hands on grips. Right FULL RUN: long dynamic stride to right, front foot stretched forward and back foot pushing off, head forward, launcher held on shoulder level; maintain long stick limbs. All figures same head diameter, same character proportions and body scale; feet bottoms align along a shared baseline. Full heads, limbs and oversized weapons fit completely in separate equal-width thirds with generous transparent gutters; no parts overlap thirds, no cropping. No detached projectile, no flame, smoke, dust, sparks, ground, background, shadows, text, labels, panels, UI, faces, chest armor, helmets, extra limbs. Painterly black ink raster matching reference; not 3D or smooth vector.

prompts.effects: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: six standalone 2D VFX textures for Doodle Rumble Fuse missile fighter, true transparent alpha sheet, 3 columns and 2 rows. Input1 Fuse sets exact ink texture and ivory/graphite/coral palette, input2 Darklord effect style only guides luminous brush quality, not violet palette. NO CHARACTERS OR WEAPONS. Each of SIX effects stays entirely within its own equal grid cell with at least 15 percent blank transparent margin and very wide transparent gutters; no touching, no panels or lines or labels. Top left: SWING TRAIL, one crescent-shaped coral and ivory dry-brush arc, soft translucent edge, black sketch flecks. Top middle: IMPACT BURST, compact radial jagged coral-orange and white starburst with sparse graphite smoke tufts, brightest center, dramatic readable silhouette. Top right: DEBRIS, small scatter of chipped graphite and bone-white shards with a few coral dots, no fire. Bottom left: SPEED LINES, horizontal broken coral and ivory marker streaks tapering LEFT, several parallel lines, no radial burst. Bottom middle: DUST, low horizontal puff of wispy graphite gray and off-white ground dust with a few scribble flecks, NO glow and NO fire. Bottom right: EXHAUST, single bright white core and coral/orange brush flame jet flowing/tapering toward LEFT, engine emission point on RIGHT, a few small charcoal smoke curls trailing left, slim horizontal form for behind missile. All same painterly rough hand-inked raster style as game reference, uneven textured outline and expressive brushwork, localized light with genuine translucent alpha. Effects only; no objects, missiles, rockets, launchers, character, ground, text, icons, UI, outline boxes, watermark, realistic fire photography, 3D or smooth vector.
